newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: Seoul stocks seen testing 800 level.
newsitem.headline: Seoul stocks seen testing 800 level.

text.p: Stocks are expected to rise in brisk trading on Thursday on the strength of expected fund inflows when the foreign stock ownership limit is raised in October, brokers said.
"The limit expansion news will still be a major boosting factor," said Chang Keun-ho of Daishin Securities. "The composite index is expected to test the 800 level."
The index ended Wednesday 21.84 points higher at 791.64.
Brokers said profit-taking would emerge towards the close if fears of an economic slump resurface.
"But the market is now on the upward slope. It is backed by several good news such as the lauching of savings scheme for stock investment in October," said Chang.
The finance ministry said earlier it would give tax breaks for workers who want to invest in the stock market through savings accounts with securities houses.
Brokers said about 1.5 trillion won would be funnelled into the market through the scheme.
